finite_mean_chart.deformation: F=(1+h/R)I+sum(bj*Bj)/R, positive definite near the accepted reference
finite_mean_chart.explicit_new_mean_provenance: Choose q as actual finite radial change averaged on the true common-reference base in declared R^2 dOmega. This is an explicit NEW six-coordinate chart; no historical roof-shift/column-offset or volume-mean identity is asserted
finite_mean_chart.generators: K0=I; B1=diag(1,-1,0); B2=diag(1,1,-2); B3=E_xy; B4=E_xz; B5=E_yz
finite_mean_chart.implicit_derivatives: h_q=1/M_h; h_bj=-M_bj/M_h; for any chart indices a,b, h_ab=-(J_a^T Hess(M) J_b)/M_h, J=d(h,b)/d(q,b)
finite_mean_chart.isotropic_exact: b=0 gives M=r_b*h/R and h=R*q/r_b on the positive branch, independently of the actual angular mask
finite_mean_chart.linear_reference_normal_is_different: (r_b/R)*<v^T(sum(ai*Ei))v> is only reference-normal displacement, not finite actual radius change
finite_mean_chart.load_chain_rule: A^T f_a; fixed dead-load tangent includes the same coordinate second derivatives; D_z=A^T D_a A
finite_mean_chart.material_mean_measure: Normalize the authentic base Lagrangian R^2 dOmega by its actual source area; use positive correction inclusion
finite_mean_chart.mean_equation: M(h,b)=r_b*<|F v|-1>_actual_Omega=q; actual area, not proxy or midpoint, normalizes the integral
finite_mean_chart.physical_chain_rule: A=d(a)/d(z)=C*J; U_z=A^T U_a; Hess_z=A^T Hess_a A+(sum of physical diagonal forces)*Hess(h)
finite_mean_chart.preserved_zero_source_state: The immutable accepted/source HOT birth scalar remains0. NEW q=0,b=0 gives h=0 and a=0, preserving this exact zero state without redefining a historical nonzero scalar
finite_mean_chart.required_integrals: M and all first/second derivatives on the complete actual mask, including its positive curve; no nonzero b midpoint or linear-mean substitute
finite_mean_chart.safe_bracket: If rho>=norm(T)_2 in metres and R+R*q/r_b>2*rho, h lies in [R*q/r_b-rho,R*q/r_b+rho], with both endpoint F positive definite
finite_mean_chart.six_coordinates: z=(q,b1,b2,b3,b4,b5) replaces, rather than supplements, the six affine amplitudes
finite_mean_chart.source_old_foundation_scope: Source registers one scalar w/R per HOT patch, with birth w=0 and uniform Winkler energy .5*rho*g*actual_area*(w-w_birth)^2. It does not specify a finite spatial mean, base-vs-roof measure, or whole3D lifting of this scalar
finite_mean_chart.volume_mean_is_different: The whole-volume isotropic coefficient mu=<r>/R is 0.989863..., while the true-base coefficient r_b/R is 0.979586...

same_field_operators.centroid_material_membership: A physical cell centroid need not belong to a tiny component. Never assume that membership or erase its positive reservoir; analytic field extensions or interval integration over the actual cell intersection must be explicit
same_field_operators.dimensioned_blocks: owner-owner D is N*m*s; owner-modal D is N*s; modal-modal D is N*s/m, for angles dimensionless and modal amplitudes metres
same_field_operators.exact_reference_radial_nulls: If the extended traction and tangent projector use the true common-base radial n, pure isotropic HOT and cold tip psi0=chi*n have zero direct tangential source/drag; elastic/contact cross coupling remains
same_field_operators.field: Use the very same complete physical placement x_o(X,a)=O_o*(X+u_o(X,a)); owner virtual field is e_k cross x_o under a spatial angular convention, modal traces are O_o*d(u_o)/d(a_i)
same_field_operators.geometry_moments: For continuous true-base manufactured tangential source, HOT forces use angular moments degree<=3 and tangent Gram blocks degree<=4; COLD chi and true endpoint/curve masks require their own actual supported angular integrals
same_field_operators.load: f_i=integral_Gamma traction.dot(psi_i) dA0; preserve actual per-material masks/correlations, trace surface, physical source parameters and declared measure
same_field_operators.normal_damping_unidentified: Original rotation traces are tangential: beta*I and beta*P_n coincide on them. They do not identify a nonzero normal damping coefficient for new radial modes
same_field_operators.not_inherited: Normal viscous drag, normal mantle traction, side-face stress, and an actual-current-area/follower extension are not supplied by the old owner-only source operator
same_field_operators.old_operator_scope: birth_continuum_motion.py:174-187 copies only 6x6 owner D and 6 owner torques, explicitly zeroing 13 radial rows; this is not a new92 basis projection
same_field_operators.physical_clock: Use actual a(z(t)) velocity/path work. J(z)*Delta_z/dt is not exactly (a_new-a_old)/dt for a finite nonlinear chart step
same_field_operators.source_centroid_rule: The saved source certifies a fixed nominal-sphere cell-centroid rule, not continuum quadrature. Moving the traction evaluation to a true base or integrating varying physical mode traces needs an explicit new rule and fresh certificate
same_field_operators.source_traction: Source supplies beta*R*(1+0.17*n_x)*(Omega cross n), beta=1.2e14 Pa*s/m, Omega=(0,0,1.1e-12) /s; global prescribed independently of owners
same_field_operators.tangential_drag: D_ij=beta*integral_Gamma (P_n psi_i).dot(P_n psi_j) dA0 with P_n=I-n*n^T; retains owner-modal and modal-modal cross terms; PSD by the full Gram integral
